_readme: Copy to app/dart_define.json (gitignored) and fill in. Then: flutter run --dart-define-from-file=dart_define.json
_local: For the local stack, run `supabase start` from the repo root and paste the API URL + publishable/anon key it prints. On a simulator use http://127.0.0.1:54321; on a physical device use your machine's LAN IP.
_hosted: For the hosted project: Supabase dashboard -> Project Settings -> API keys.
_keys: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is the legacy name and still works; newer CLI versions print SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY instead. Set whichever your CLI gives you — the app accepts both.
